answer: Locks are recorded in glacier, expire in delta, and signal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 53 aliases as a result needs 158 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 20 dollars in locked collateral and another 11 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
